notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Nintendo Switch only (RAWG lists only Nintendo Switch), so steam=None. StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, in Category:Stubs): only its Table of Contents is written. The contents page lists Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough, six area pages (Withered Wasteland, Bleak Beach, Rocky Ridges, Sparkling Skylands, Palette Town, Bubbly Basin), Pokédex and Habitats, but none of those subpages exists yet. Chapters use those area page names in contents order (swNames); the summaries are only placeholders, because there is no written text to check what each area holds. StrategyWiki categories also mention Nintendo Switch 2 and Omega Force; RAWG names Koei Tecmo and Game Freak as developers. pokemon.fandom.com answers the API under "Pokémon Pokopia", with about 434 linked pages; names only were looked at, nothing copied. RAWG has no playtime or tags yet.
